Name: NCA Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CCC/CSCC)
Description: The National Cybersecurity Authority (NCA) Cloud Cybersecurity Controls (CCC-2:2024 / CSCC) set mandatory cybersecurity requirements for Cloud Service Tenants (CSTs) and Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Requirements.Name: 1-1-T-1 Cybersecurity Roles and Responsibilities in Cloud
Requirements.Description: Cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and RACI matrix for cloud services stakeholders, administrators, and Authorizing Officials must be clearly defined, documented, and approved.

Requirements.Name: 1-2-T-1 Cloud Cybersecurity Risk Management & Posture
Requirements.Description: Establish a continuous cloud cybersecurity risk assessment methodology, risk register, and automated threat posture monitoring for all cloud assets.

Requirements.Name: 1-3-T-1 Compliance with Cybersecurity Standards and Regulations
Requirements.Description: Ensure continuous, real-time compliance monitoring of cloud subscriptions, policies, and resources against national regulatory mandates.

Attributes.SubSection: 1-3 Compliance with Cybersecurity Standards, Laws, and Regulations

Requirements.Name: 1-4-T-1 Cybersecurity in Human Resources & Sensitive Operations
Requirements.Description: Personnel with privileged access to sensitive cloud functions (Key Management, Cloud Administration, IAM) must undergo strict verification and access reviews.

Requirements.Name: 2-1-T-1 Cloud Asset Management and Technical Inventory
Requirements.Description: Maintain an accurate, updated, and automated inventory of all cloud subscriptions, virtual networks, compute instances, databases, and serverless assets.

Requirements.Name: 2-2-T-1 Cloud Identity, Privileged Access & MFA Management
Requirements.Description: Enforce mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for privileged and remote cloud users, least privilege authorization, secure session lockouts, and prompt revoking of unused credentials.

Requirements.Name: 2-3-T-1 Cloud System Isolation & Information Processing Protection
Requirements.Description: Ensure complete separation and isolation of cloud workloads, hardened baseline configurations, endpoint detection (EDR), and prevention of unauthorized system modifications.

Attributes.SubSection: 2-3 Information System and Processing Facilities Protection

Requirements.Name: 2-4-T-1 Cloud Network Security Management & Segmentation
Requirements.Description: Implement virtual network segmentation, Network Security Groups (NSGs), firewall filtering on management ports (SSH 22, RDP 3389), private endpoints, and DDoS protection.

Requirements.Name: 2-5-T-1 Mobile & Remote Cloud Management Device Security
Requirements.Description: Enforce secure sanitation, screen lockouts, and centralized compliance policies on devices connecting to cloud administration interfaces.

Requirements.Name: 2-6-T-1 Cloud Data Protection, Classification & Public Access Block
Requirements.Description: Prohibit public access to cloud storage containers, enforce secure transfer protocols (TLS 1.2+), and classify sensitive information stored across cloud services.

Requirements.Name: 2-7-T-1 Cloud Cryptography & Transit/Rest Encryption
Requirements.Description: Apply strong cryptographic primitives according to National Cryptographic Standards (NCS), customer-managed keys (CMK), and TLS encryption for all data in-transit and at-rest.

Requirements.Name: 2-8-T-1 Cloud Backup and Disaster Recovery Management
Requirements.Description: Ensure regular, secure, and isolated backups of cloud databases, virtual disks, and application configurations with verified periodic recovery tests.

Requirements.Name: 2-9-T-1 Cloud Vulnerability & Patch Management
Requirements.Description: Conduct continuous vulnerability scans, automated OS patching, container image scanning, and timely remediation of high/critical cloud security flaws.

Requirements.Name: 2-10-T-1 Cloud Penetration Testing & Defense Verification
Requirements.Description: Periodically assess the resilience of cloud workloads, APIs, and public endpoints through authorized penetration testing and attack simulations.

Requirements.Name: 2-11-T-1 Cloud Event Logs, SIEM Integration & 12-Month Retention
Requirements.Description: Activate and protect comprehensive audit logs (Activity Logs, Diagnostic Logs, Network Flow Logs), stream them to centralized SIEM, and retain for a minimum of 12 months.

Attributes.SubSection: 2-11 Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management

Requirements.Name: 2-12-T-1 Cloud Incident Response & Threat Intelligence
Requirements.Description: Implement automated threat detection, incident response procedures, real-time alert notifications, and statutory incident reporting to NCA.

Requirements.Name: 2-14-T-1 Cloud Web Application & API Security (WAF)
Requirements.Description: Protect external web apps, microservices, and APIs using Web Application Firewalls (WAF), HTTPS enforcement, and client certificate authentication.

Requirements.Name: 2-15-T-1 Cryptographic Key Management & Vault Protection
Requirements.Description: Store and manage cryptographic keys, secrets, and certificates in dedicated HSM/Key Vaults with purge protection, auto-rotation, and strict RBAC.

Requirements.Name: 3-1-T-1 Cloud Business Continuity & Resilience (BCM)
Requirements.Description: Develop, document, and test cloud disaster recovery procedures, multi-region failover, and high availability architectures for critical systems.

Requirements.Name: 4-1-T-1 Cloud Supply Chain & Third-Party Cybersecurity
Requirements.Description: Enforce cybersecurity requirements in third-party cloud agreements, managed service providers, and cloud marketplace integrations.
